title: Release archives fail on certificates
situation: Release archive jobs now fail. Earlier runs of the same code archived fine. The agent proposes re-running the job on more runners in parallel until one succeeds.

evidence.text: Error: your account has reached the maximum number of certificates; no development provisioning profiles found.
Account certificate inventory: 12 development certificates, 11 named 'Created via API', two created today.
The archive step uses automatic signing with provisioning updates allowed, on a fresh CI runner each time.
Nothing in the repository changed between the last good run and the first failure.
